# ankra_helm_registry (Resource)

A Helm chart registry connected to the organisation, so its charts appear in the catalogue and addons can install them. Reference it from an `ankra_cluster` addon with `registry_name = ankra_helm_registry.<name>.name` and `registry_url = ankra_helm_registry.<name>.url`. The counterpart of `ankra helm registries create`, `update` and `delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_helm_registry_credential" "acme" {
  name     = "acme-charts"
  username = "robot$acme"
  password = var.acme_registry_token
}

resource "ankra_helm_registry" "acme" {
  name              = "acme"
  url               = "oci://registry.acme.example/charts"
  credential_name   = ankra_helm_registry_credential.acme.name
  read_job_interval = 600
}

resource "ankra_helm_registry" "bitnami" {
  name           = "bitnami"
  url            = "https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami"
  exclude_charts = ["wordpress"]
}

# A registry and its credential created in another project, by slug or ID,
# rather than the provider's project.
resource "ankra_helm_registry_credential" "team" {
  name       = "team-charts"
  username   = "robot-team"
  password   = var.acme_registry_token
  project_id = "data-team"
}

resource "ankra_helm_registry" "team" {
  name            = "team"
  url             = "oci://registry.acme.example/team"
  credential_name = ankra_helm_registry_credential.team.name
  project_id      = "data-team"
}

# An ankra_cluster addon then names the registry it installs from:
#
#   addons {
#     name                     = "api"
#     chart_name               = "api"
#     chart_version            = "1.4.0"
#     registry_name            = ankra_helm_registry.acme.name
#     registry_url             = ankra_helm_registry.acme.url
#     registry_credential_name = ankra_helm_registry_credential.acme.name
#     namespace                = "api"
#   }

variable "acme_registry_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Registry name, unique in the organisation. Changing it replaces the registry.
- `url` (String) Registry URL: `oci://...` for an OCI registry, `https://...` for an HTTP chart repository. Without a trailing slash, which the platform strips. Changing it replaces the registry.

### Optional

- `credential_name` (String) Name of the `ankra_helm_registry_credential` used to pull from a private registry. The platform cannot change it in place, so changing it replaces the registry.
- `exclude_charts` (List of String) Charts to leave out of the catalogue. HTTP registries only. Changing it replaces the registry.
- `project_id` (String) Project to create the registry in, by ID or slug, instead of the provider's project. Every request for this registry is then made in that project. The platform does not report a registry's project, so this is kept as configured and a move made outside Terraform is not detected; it is null after an import. Changing it replaces the registry.
- `read_job_interval` (Number) Seconds between automatic background syncs of the chart index: `0` disables them, otherwise between 60 and 86400. The platform default is 120.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `kind` (String) `oci` or `http`, from the URL scheme.
- `last_sync_error` (String) Why the most recent index sync failed, when it did.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Helm registries are imported by name.
terraform import ankra_helm_registry.acme acme
```
